meta.name: The Silent Sea
meta.description: During a perilous 24-hour mission on the moon, space explorers try to retrieve samples from an abandoned research facility steeped in classified secrets.

videos.title: Balhae Lunar Research Station
videos.overview: Director Choi's briefing about the mission leaves Song Ji-an displeased. Reaching the research station alone proves no easy feat for the crew.

videos.title: Three Storages
videos.overview: The crew's initial findings are at odds with their knowledge of the research station. Split into threes, the members set out to look for the sample.

videos.title: Cause of Death
videos.overview: Ji-an's body cam captures a startling moment of life and death. Submerged in sweat, Gong Soo-chan shows worrisome signs of an unusual infection.

videos.title: The Truth Comes Out
videos.overview: Han Yun-jae updates the director and gets access to a restricted area. The crew learns of the sample's powers and the true motive behind their mission.

videos.title: Secret Storage
videos.overview: Recalling her sister's encrypted message, Ji-an searches the database for Luna. A young intruder and a double-crosser emerge from the shadows.

videos.title: Key to Salvation
videos.overview: E2, Ryu Tae-suk and the samples go missing. Seeing a familiar name on the intruder, Ji-an follows her down the vents for answers.

videos.title: Luna
videos.overview: Ji-an opens a hard drive that chronicles Song Won-kyung's life and work on the station. Meanwhile, others uncover the remains of the experiment.

videos.title: The Silent Sea
videos.overview: Racing against time as the research station falls under destruction, the surviving crew members decide on the fate of the mission — and their own.

meta.slogan: A deserted Moon base. A deadly mission.
